學校簡介 
IDRAC Business School is signatory to the ERASMUS Charter and offers Study Abroad programs to all his 
partners with 2 programs fully taught in English and 1 in French. 
All of them are course packages: students can get up to 30 ECTS in each program. Each student can 
choose the program that best fits his needs but cannot mix courses from different programs in order to avoid 
schedule clashes. 
The IDRAC Business School BBA program in English is opened in Lyon and Paris for fall and spring 
semesters. Bordeaux, Montpellier and Nantes campuses open for spring semester. The program in French 
is available on 9 different campuses. 
The PGE in English is opened in Lyon both during fall and spring semesters and allows to be mixed up with 
French students. This program received the Grade de Master (one of the highest recognition given by the 
Ministry of education to a program in France). 
All our programs offer the possibility to learn French as a foreign language. Students can enroll in the French 
seminar at the start of the semester, intensive seminar in French. And classes are programmed regularly 
during the semester.

IDRAC Business School is signatory to the ERASMUS Charter and offers Study Abroad programs to all his 
partners with 2 programs fully taught in English and 1 in French.

choose the program that best fits his needs but cannot mix courses from different programs in order to avoid 
schedule clashes. 
The IDRAC Business School BBA program in English is opened in Lyon and Paris for fall and spring 
semesters. Bordeaux, Montpellier and Nantes campuses open for spring semester. The program in French 
is available on 9 different campuses.

French students. This program received the Grade de Master (one of the highest recognition given by the 
Ministry of education to a program in France).

seminar at the start of the semester, intensive seminar in French. And classes are programmed regularly

【中央公開介紹參考；年份／116適用性未確認】住宿：Housing in Munich unfortunately is a major issue. We are only able to house 
about 50% to 60% of our incoming students in student residence halls (they 
are subsidized by the state and therefore only cost around 280 to 360 Euro). 
Since there is no fair way to distribute the rooms, we use a lottery system in 
order to assign them. Those who are not lucky need to find a room on the 
private market. Although we do assist students by handing out information 
on how to find affordable housing, it is up to the student to find 
accommodation. Private rooms are much more expensive (starting at around 
500 Euro in shared apartments) and students should also consider living in 
the suburbs or towns along the regional train lines.（慕尼黑應用科學大學.pdf PDF，第1頁；https://drive.google.com/file/d/1HXmwetQhMyVPJXSf6lqZWdMJKKdX2WvV/view）

【中央公開介紹參考；年份／116適用性未確認】申請資格：Undergraduate 
學校簡介 Chiba University is one of the largest and most vibrant national universities in 
Japan.  Chiba University has four campuses at Nishi Chiba, Inohana, Matsudo and 
Kashiwanoha, all located in Chiba Prefecture. The main campus is Nishi Chiba 
campus in Chiba City, which has a population of about 968,000. 
It can be reached by train in one hour from Tokyo, and is about 45 minutes by car 
from Narita International Airport.（千葉大學.pdf PDF，第1頁；https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Jrf5MU1S6JaNG5QGfVxGwzZabaAVtcxQ/view）
【中央公開介紹參考；年份／116適用性未確認】語言要求：For undergraduate exchange programs (J-PAC): 
・Interational Liberal Arts Program participants must have received Japanese 
language tuition of at least 50 contact hours at a recognized educational 
institution. Students whose Japanese proficiency level is below N2 should 
demonstrate sufficient ability to communicate in English. English level: B2 or 
higher(只接受 TOEFL iBT or IELTS.) 
 
・Japanese Studies Program participants should at least have Japanese language 
competence equivalent to the pass level N2 of the Japanese Language Proficiency 
Test administered by the Japan Foundation.（千葉大學.pdf PDF，第1頁；https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Jrf5MU1S6JaNG5QGfVxGwzZabaAVtcxQ/view）

application_deadline: 中央線上2026/12/4 12:00、系所紙本12/11 17:00（臺灣時間）；外校116當期提名／申請期限尚未取得核對。
application_info:
校內線上申請2026/11/16 09:00至12/4 12:00（臺灣時間）。紙本資料另須12/11 17:00前交系所；系所12/18 17:00前送國際處，不能把系所送件日當學生截止日。

校內初審只取得推薦資格；須由外校另行審查並核發入學許可，且取得簽證。

校內必繳正式外語檢定，不限級數；英檢須兩年內有效，線上關閉前須備妥並上傳，不接受網路截圖或補繳。外校要求之語檢分開查核。

校內必繳：簽核申請表、家長同意書、個資同意書、正式語檢影本、中文歷年成績、中文名次證明、加蓋國際處章戳之國際移動力證明。

簡章第4頁允許外校語檢至外校截止前補繳，第7頁規定提名前取得；請依較早的提名時點準備並向國際處確認。

外校文件／表格尚未取得並完成116適用性核對；中央通用提名流程不是外校文件清單。
tuition_info:
中央交換期間仍須註冊及繳本校學雜費；外校是否免學費與其他校方收費須逐方案核對，不保證一律免繳。

課程說明 
We do not have a full time course in Japanese language and culture. We do have a 
Japanese Language class and a Japanese Affairs class that are compulsory for all exchange 
students to take (both classes take place once per week). For other classes, please let the 
student express his/her wishes. We will then discuss the possibilities with the relevant 
Faculty or Professors.  Students can find the syllabus of each Fac ulty/Graduate School on 
the following page (unfortunately only in Japanese, although the course titles are often 
also in English): http://www.osaka-cu.ac.jp/ja/education/class/syllabus（大阪公立大學.pdf PDF，第1頁；https://drive.google.com/file/d/15A2lMad8G7yw_QNydmv3v8ZJZ5UvlZLn/view）
